================================================================================
SC-MULTIPAT: comma-separated pattern lists in val/var definitions
================================================================================

// scalameta's Issue1872 semanticdb fixture: a name and a pattern bound in one
// definition (SLS PatDef ::= Pattern2 {',' Pattern2}).
val a2_1, List(a2_2) = List(1, 2)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (comment)
  (comment)
  (val_definition
    pattern: (identifier)
    pattern: (case_class_pattern
      type: (type_identifier)
      pattern: (identifier))
    value: (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (arguments
        (integer_literal)
        (integer_literal)))))

================================================================================
SC-MULTIPAT-VAR: the same list in a var definition
================================================================================

var e, List(f) = List(1, 2)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (var_definition
    pattern: (identifier)
    pattern: (case_class_pattern
      type: (type_identifier)
      pattern: (identifier))
    value: (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (arguments
        (integer_literal)
        (integer_literal)))))

================================================================================
SC-MULTIPAT-NAMES: pure name lists keep the identifiers node
================================================================================

val a, b = (1, 2)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (val_definition
    pattern: (identifiers
      (identifier)
      (identifier))
    value: (tuple_expression
      (integer_literal)
      (integer_literal))))
